notes.Scope note: This dashboard focuses on fire safety for crew habitats: stations, Moon and Mars bases, pressurised rovers and spacesuits. Rocket-accident cases are shown in the Appendix for context only; engine combustion is not driven by cabin gravity.
notes.Gravity slider note: The gravity control applies only to cabin and material fires. It does not apply to rocket-engine combustion.
notes.Ranker note: Rankings are computed by a transparent, rule-based scoring model (weights and per-feature contributions are shown). They are not machine-learning predictions.
